articles.title: Saudi Arabia reportedly carried out secret strikes on Iran during West Asia war
articles.summary: Saudi Arabia has reportedly conducted its first known direct covert military strikes on Iranian soil, significantly escalating regional tensions. This action follows earlier U.S. and Israeli strikes against Iran this year, underscoring a deepening geopolitical conflict in the Middle East. Such developments highlight the volatile security environment for SSB aspirants to analyze.

articles.title: Misadventure happens from across border, we’re ready to quell it: Navy chief-designate after Munir’s warning
articles.summary: India's Navy chief-designate affirmed the nation's robust readiness to counter any 'misadventure' originating from across the border. His statement came in response to a recent warning from Pakistan's General Munir, highlighting the Indian Navy's unwavering commitment to vigilance and its capabilities to effectively quell any threats to national security and maritime sovereignty, ensuring preparedness against regional challenges.

articles.title: My graduation cap runs Rust
articles.summary: The author recounts their first-time college graduation experience, expressing novelty with the cap and gown tradition. They highlight a specific American cultural practice where academic regalia is rented rather than purchased for the ceremony, emphasizing the requirement for its return. This detail provides insight into certain US university customs.
